object: Finite probe-table carrier discriminator using a qubit density carrier with explicit readout constraints

installed_incomplete.why: The Z/X table pins a and b but leaves c free, so a second coordinate-distinct density carrier can reproduce the measured table.

forced_complete.why: The complete Z/X/Y table pins a,b,c to C1, so no coordinate-distinct C2 can reproduce it.

installed_incomplete_scrambled.why: Same cardinality as installed_incomplete, different measured X value; the satisfying C2 must change.

forced_complete_scrambled.why: Same complete probe set but a different measured Y value; this refutes a value-independent forced verdict.

invalid_measured_z.why: No valid density carrier has Z readout 2; reproduce ON is UNSAT while reproduce OFF admits a mismatch witness.

non_isomorphism_predicate: C2 is coordinate-distinct iff at least one of a,b,c differs from C1; no gauge quotient is applied in v0.
decision_rule: solver status sat => installed because a valid coordinate-distinct C2 exists; solver status unsat => forced because no such C2 exists; unknown fails the build
claim_ceiling: FORCED here = no second carrier with DIFFERENT (a,b,c) coordinates reproduces the table = COORDINATE-uniqueness vs the reference, NOT isomorphic/ontological uniqueness; no gauge quotient is applied in v0. For these fixtures only: installed means a second density carrier reproduces the measured incomplete probe table. No rho exclusion, no Hilbert exclusion, no Rung-0.5 collapse, no promotion.

surviving_alternatives.statement: The Boolean lattice of P-invariant subsets may be admitted as the exclusion-composition surface after Q.
The Boolean lattice of P-invariant subsets may remain only a derived or dual presentation of Q; counting and cardinality stay open.
